      public void putMark(Student student, String courseName, int att1, int att2, int finalExam)
      Puts a mark for a student in a course. Mark consists of: attendance 1, attendance 2 and final exam score.

      courseName - name of the course
      att1 - first attendance score
      att2 - second attendance score
      finalExam - final exam score

      public int getHIndex()
      Calculates H-index based on research papers citations. H-index is the maximum value h such that the teacher has at least h papers with h or more citations.

      public boolean isResearcher()
      Checks if teacher is considered a researcher. Teacher is a researcher if: degree allows research OR teacher has published at least one paper
      Returns:
      true if researcher
